title: Generic spherical unitary dual for Chevalley groups over local fields
summary: We prove that a generic spherical parameter for the graded affine Hecke algebra with equal parameters is unitary if and only if its normalized intertwining forms are positive on the reflection representation and on the irreducible constituents of its second symmetric power. The proof combines a signature formula for the reflection representation, Yu's uniform two-wall operation, a simply-laced Jantzen recursion, and a root-poset analysis.
